postconditions.description: The output is the concatenation of the modified versions of strings a and b.

postconditions.expression: all(c in modified_a for c in a)
postconditions.description: All characters from the original string a are present in the modified string a.

postconditions.expression: all(c in modified_b for c in b)
postconditions.description: All characters from the original string b are present in the modified string b.
